200 Returned if Tenable Web App Scanning successfully queued a WAS findings export request.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to export WAS findings.
409
Returned if your request was a duplicate of an ongoing export that was already submitted. Tenable
Web App Scanning prevents duplicate exports from running concurrently. For example, export requests
with the same filters.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting and Concurrency Limiting.
